objs.name: document
objs.description: Central managed artifact representing policies, guidelines, procedural instructions, work instructions or other controlled content that passes through creation, editing, release, distribution, versioning, and archiving lifecycles.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: Classification of the document (e.g. Policy, Guideline, Procedural Instruction, Work Instruction).

attributes.name: document_level
attributes.description: Hierarchical level in the document pyramid (Level 1–4).

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: User-defined title portion of the document name.

attributes.name: abbreviation
attributes.description: Type abbreviation prefix used in the document name (e.g. RL).

attributes.name: consecutive_number
attributes.description: Cross-client 4-digit sequential number per document type.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the document (e.g. Editing, Released, Out of Force).

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the document.

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date from which the released version is valid.

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Calculated expiry date based on Valid From plus the validity period.

attributes.name: period_of_extended_validity
attributes.description: Configurable time span for validity check cycle (default 3 years).

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Configurable retention period after invalidation (default 10 years).

attributes.name: source_format
attributes.description: Original file format of the document content (e.g. Word, Excel, PowerPoint).

attributes.name: language
attributes.description: Original language of the document content.

attributes.name: scope
attributes.description: Applicable scope or areas of validity for the document.

attributes.name: relevant_companies
attributes.description: Companies to which the document applies.

attributes.name: references
attributes.description: Links to master data, IT applications, or other referenced items.

attributes.name: client_visibility
attributes.description: Specification of in which clients the document is visible in a multi-client system.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: Controlled sub-document attached to a main document; subject to its own versioning and released together with the main document's release cycle.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the attachment.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Lifecycle status of the attachment.

objs.name: additional_info
objs.description: Non-controlled supplementary material (e.g. photos, screenshots, brief instructions) added to a document that is not subject to a formal release cycle.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: Formal request created by an author to propose amendments to an existing released document, tracked and managed within the document cockpit.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current processing status of the change proposal (e.g. Created, Planned, Completed).

objs.name: request_for_validity_extension
objs.description: System-generated request triggered 30 days before a document's validity expires, requiring workflow-supported processing to extend or revise validity.

objs.name: request_for_override
objs.description: Formal request to invalidate a released document and archive it, initiating the out-of-force workflow.

objs.name: request_for_reactivation
objs.description: Formal request to re-validate a previously invalidated (archived) document, restricted to the Business Admin group.

objs.name: user
objs.description: An individual person who participates in document management processes in one or more roles (author, co-author, reviewer, releaser, translator, reader).

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: Named group of users used to assign read or other authorizations and distribution memberships (e.g. Reader - Document Management, Archive Group, Business Admin Group).

objs.name: workflow
objs.description: System-supported process instance that orchestrates approval steps (Creator, Review, Release) with electronic signatures and email notifications.

attributes.name: workflow_type
attributes.description: Type of workflow (e.g. Document Release, Validity Extension, Override, Reactivation, Acknowledgement, Translation Release).

objs.name: electronic_signature
objs.description: Signed confirmation by a workflow participant recorded for audit trail purposes at each workflow step.

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: Configured list of user groups and persons assigned to a document to be informed or required to acknowledge upon release.

attributes.name: distribution_type
attributes.description: Type of distribution: by email or for acknowledgement.

objs.name: document_template
objs.description: Predefined template associated with a document type that can be selected when creating new document objects, supporting TAG technology for automatic metadata insertion.

objs.name: report
objs.description: Role-specific evaluation or search report available in the system for monitoring documents, statuses, acknowledgements and other criteria.

attributes.name: report_name
attributes.description: Name of the report (e.g. Status Report: Documents & Instruction, Search for Documents & Instructions).

attributes.name: selection_parameters
attributes.description: Configurable filter criteria that influence the evaluation results.

objs.name: dashboard
objs.description: Role-specific user interface view presenting relevant document lists, tasks, and evaluations to readers or authors.

attributes.name: role
attributes.description: Target role for the dashboard (e.g. Reader, Author).

objs.name: client
objs.description: Organizational tenant in a multi-client system within which documents are visible or managed.

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: A new document object is attached in the system with selection of document type and optional template, triggering property editing.

evts.name: edit_document_content
evts.description: The document content is opened and modified using the local Office editing client.

evts.name: edit_document_properties
evts.description: Metadata and attributes of a document are maintained or updated via the properties dialog.

evts.name: convert_document_to_pdf
evts.description: After saving, the system automatically converts the document to PDF for web display.

evts.name: start_release_workflow
evts.description: The author or co-author initiates the 3-step approval workflow (Creator, Review, Release) for a document.

evts.name: sign_creator_step
evts.description: The registered author signs the document in the first workflow step (Creator).

evts.name: review_document
evts.description: One or more reviewers check the document for technical and formal correctness and complete their workflow task.

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: One or more releasers approve the document, completing the release workflow and triggering publication.

evts.name: reject_document
evts.description: A reviewer or releaser rejects the document during the approval workflow, canceling subsequent tasks.

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: After release, the document is automatically made visible to addressed readers.

evts.name: create_new_version
evts.description: A new editing version of a released document is created due to content changes, attribute changes, attachment changes, or scheduled change proposals.

evts.name: create_attachment
evts.description: A new controlled attachment is added to a document, triggering a new version of the main document.

evts.name: modify_attachment
evts.description: An existing attachment is changed, triggering a new version of the main document.

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: An attachment is marked for archiving and archived upon release of the next main document version.

evts.name: create_additional_info
evts.description: A non-controlled additional information object is added to a document without affecting the main document's version.

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: An author creates a change proposal for an existing released document, notifying the document author by email.

evts.name: schedule_change_proposal
evts.description: A change proposal is planned for implementation, creating a new version of the document.

evts.name: complete_change_proposal
evts.description: The author documents the resolution of the change proposal; the creator receives email notification and the proposal is removed from the document display.

evts.name: create_request_for_validity_extension
evts.description: The system automatically generates a validity extension request 30 days before the document's Valid Until date.

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: A releaser (or author/reviewer/releaser) confirms additional validity, updating the Valid Until date and deleting the request.

evts.name: create_request_for_override
evts.description: A user with write access creates an override request for a document, automatically starting the override workflow.

evts.name: declare_out_of_force
evts.description: The override workflow is completed, setting the document status to Out of Force, revoking rights except for the archive group, and starting the archive duration.

evts.name: delete_expired_document
evts.description: After the archive period expires, the physically archived document is permanently deleted from the system.

evts.name: create_request_for_reactivation
evts.description: A member of the Business Admin group creates a reactivation request for an invalidated document.

evts.name: reactivate_document
evts.description: The reactivation workflow is confirmed, creating a new version restoring metadata, authorizations, distribution lists, and reactivating archived attachments.

evts.name: assign_authorization
evts.description: Read or write authorizations are assigned to users or user groups for a specific document via property editing.

evts.name: maintain_distribution_list
evts.description: User groups or persons are added to or modified on a document's distribution list for email or acknowledgement distribution.

evts.name: distribute_by_email
evts.description: Upon release, email notifications are sent to users and user groups on the distribution-by-email list.

evts.name: request_acknowledgement
evts.description: Upon release, users on the acknowledgement distribution list receive workflow-supported requests to confirm acknowledgement.

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: A reader confirms acknowledgement of a released document version via the workflow task.

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: Released document content is translated into another language by a translator.

attributes.name: target_language
attributes.description: The language into which the document is being translated.

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: The translated language version is checked and released via a dedicated approval workflow, making it visible to readers in the corresponding language.

o2o.description: An Attachment belongs to and is controlled by a main Document; its lifecycle is tied to the Document's release cycle.
Additional Info is supplementary material attached to a Document without affecting its version or release.
A Change Proposal belongs to a specific Document and proposes amendments to it.
A Request For Validity Extension is linked to the Document whose validity must be checked.
A Request For Override is created for a specific Document to initiate its invalidation.
A Request For Reactivation references the invalidated Document to be reactivated.
A Document Template is associated with a document type and used when creating new Document objects.
A Distribution List is maintained per Document to control notification and acknowledgement upon release.
A Distribution List includes User Groups whose members receive distribution notifications or acknowledgement requests.
A Distribution List can include individual Users in addition to User Groups.
A User is assigned to one or more User Groups that determine their authorizations and role capabilities.
A Document can reference another Document (e.g. local extension referencing original, or cross-references via attributes).
A Document is configured for visibility in one or more Clients in a multi-client system.
